title: BoschDoc: source documents on Hieronymus Bosch
institution: Huygens Institute, Radboud University Nijmegen and Stadsarchief 's-Hertogenbosch (Bosch Research and Conservation Project)
notes: Database of 939 entries (the home page says almost 1,000) about Bosch, his family, patrons and works: mostly handwritten court records, accounts and inventories of 's-Hertogenbosch, plus some early printed works and Spanish manuscripts, each with facsimile, transcription, remarks and translation. The site was published for the 2016 Bosch anniversary and its data files date from 2021, with no later change seen. The counts cover the entries that have a transcription, and the 56 entries without one are left out. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
